Jose Lopez

Head of AI, builder and operator focused on secure, useful AI systems in production.

Short bio

Jose Lopez leads AI at bunny.net, where he built an AI Gateway for high-volume production traffic across bunny.net's global network. Previously, he built the AI team and platform at IriusRisk and shipped product-integrated agents for threat modeling, risk assessment and secure-by-design attack simulation.

Earlier, he built large-scale machine-learning systems at Mimecast, led graph-machine-learning research at Zed Worldwide, and worked on defense and critical-infrastructure software at ELIMCO Sistemas.
